## Case (Ca)

Tickets are units of conversation; a Case is the unit of accountability — one customer problem spanning tickets, days, and owners, with severity, findings, and a resolution record. It LINKS the related tickets (reusing the existing Ticket block) rather than replacing them.

### Non-goals

No SLA machinery (Ticket already owns SLA; a case is judged by resolution quality, not clock). No customer-visible portal view.
